view_chain: DOCX -> native OFD -> PDF -> macOS Preview
default_view_chain: DOCX -> default OFD -> PDF -> macOS Preview
reviewer: gpt-6.1-terra (High reasoning; AI visual reviewer, not human sign-off)
review_timing_note: This is completion of the full visual review. The exact time of the earlier DOCX-only Preview check was not separately recorded; it occurred on 2026-11-07.

release_profile.scope: Fixed generated-layout.docx only: explicit Native and default Native, pages 1-2 each, physical Regular/Bold.
release_profile.visual_environment: macOS 26.6.2 (25G83), Preview 11.0; independent Poppler 144 DPI PNG review.
release_profile.functional_result: Both modes preserve all 189 non-whitespace source characters exactly in OFD and PDF without duplicate PDF text; 7 physical Bold text objects and 3 blue table fills; selected Regular/Bold subset outlines match pinned source faces. Seven loaded Ofdrw.Net DLLs match exact candidate package assets.

additional_visual_review.f08_and_controls: Five OFD -> PDF -> Preview pages and matching 144 DPI PNGs reviewed; no observed highlight seam or visible clipping/overlap.
additional_visual_review.plain_text_tabs: One 40-row plain-text candidate-package page reviewed in Preview and PNG; gap before 说明 visible after 数量 12 and later rows.
additional_visual_review.f06: Four candidate-package PDF -> OFD -> PDF pages reviewed in Preview against rendered source PDFs; original source PDFs were not themselves opened in Preview.

known_limitations: Q05 is limited to the physical Regular/Bold profile and fixed two-page DOCX in two modes; it does not retest a Regular-only synthetic-bold configuration or arbitrary Word fidelity.
macOS Preview Find, raw Unicode Copy and paragraph PDF selection geometry were not verified in this review.
F06 does not establish general RTL semantics or real-reader Copy/Find; F07 does not establish full archival conformance or certification.
publication_status: Local candidate Preview acceptance only; tag, NuGet publication, public consumption and Pages deployment are separate gates.
